scope: Pembroke 6x6 assembly slice: composition Parts with source-stated kit counts (Pembroke 6ft CAD page 6x6 material list), value Parts (rail, U-channel, metal insert, wide-board picket), and the authored model candidate excluded pending Amendment 008 and receiving geometry
historical_evidence: workspace/reports/pembroke-assembly-consumer-probe.json (consumer validation via the consumer's own environment in this run; probe payload rerun each advance)
workspace/catalog/pembroke-6x6-consumer-model.json (private diagnostic candidate; transformation rerun each advance)
limitations: Composition Parts carry identity only: per-panel counts (2 rails, 1 metal insert, 6 pickets, 2 U-channels) are manufacturer kit-inventory statements with their bases in the dataset, not installed-geometry derivations.

Kit counts are manufacturer inventory statements (Tokens), not installed geometry: the U-channel length 61in equals the two-rail chain closure 72 - 2*5.5 exactly, and the picket stock 64.25in exceeds the 61in run by an implied 3.25in seating (config-dependent, not a measured engagement).

The local CAD raster's canonical OCR is unusable (2 garbled labels, mean confidence 0); its corroborating labels (72 width, 5.5/61/5.5 chain) are recorded in workspace/reports/pembroke-source-review/findings.md as diagnostic re-OCR evidence only — no fact anchors to that OCR and no Part cites the PNG.
Receiving geometry (rail slot depth, picket seating depth, post rail-socket depth) remains absent: no fitted dimension, seated cut length or engagement check is validated.
The authored model candidate is excluded from models[] by the pending numeric provenance mapping (Amendment 008) and by the invalid_quantity refusals that ARE the missing receiving geometry.
Rail placements are drawing-derived authored choices from the section chain (5.5 + 61 + 5.5 = 72); the datum interpretation is unconfirmed.
The model authors no post opinion: no post Part with citable values exists (the panel kit lists no posts; the gate lists' 4x4x76 socket posts are gate-scope evidence only).
Posts, caps and concrete are separate purchases: the master install post-hole specs (10in diameter for 4x4 posts, 30-36in deep) are family-level instructions, not Pembroke-specific fitted dimensions.
Exact SKU identity for the 6x6 kit is unverified; the Home Depot PWPR-T-G11-3-6X8 product page documents the 6x8 sibling, not this 6x6 configuration.

The model fragment authors no requirement for the bottom-rail metal insert (1 per panel, manufacturer kit inventory): the consumer fixings channel draws per_panel quantities at the panel centre unless edge-bound, and no source states the insert's seating inside the rail. A resolved BOM from the model alone would buy 0 inserts; purchasing must read the dataset composition and the value Part. Recorded as deliberate refusal in the draft's unresolved_fields.

Gap-closing round 2026-09-07: width options 72/96 in recorded in the dataset (specsheet p2 + master install p3 + both CAD-page panel lists); the .055in T&G wall gauge now publishes on the picket Part (specsheet p2, twice-observed); 2in recommended ground clearance and the conflicting wind-rating claims (110/130 FAQ vs 120/137 high-wind method, master install p15) are recorded as family-level dataset claims. Explicit inspected-not-claimed gaps: panel post-height pairing, panel-scope post cap, rail slot dimension, receiving geometry.
